metadata.title: Disc-presheaves and normal invariants
metadata.abstract: In this note, we elaborate on a result of Krannich--Kupers--Mehzer on Disc-presheaves. We show that equivalences of $2$-truncated Disc-presheaves of manifolds yields homotopy equivalences with trivial normal invariant. As an application, we show that two closed, simply connected manifolds are homeomorphic if and only if their $2$-truncated Disc-presheaves are equivalent.

analysis.limitations: 整体同胚应用有闭、单连通假设；不能泛推任意基本群或光滑微分同胚分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
